self-observation.translation: n. 对自身外貌的观察； 自省, 内省

self-opinion.definition:
n. Opinion, especially high opinion, of one's self; an
   overweening estimate of one's self or of one's own opinion.
self-opinion.translation: n. 自我估价, 自负, 固执己见

self-opinionated.translation: a. 自负的, 固执己见的

self-opinioned.definition:
a. Having a high opinion of one's self; opinionated;
   conceited.
self-opinioned.translation:
a. 自负的, 刚愎自用的, 固执己见的
[法] 固执的, 执迷不悟的, 顽固的

self-organisation.translation: [网络] 自我组织能力；组织行为

self-organization.definition: n. organizing yourself (especially organizing your own labor union)
self-organization.translation:
n. 自行组织的工会
[计] 自组织

self-organized.translation: adj. 自组织的; 自发的

self-organizing.translation: [计] 自组织; 自组织的

self-organizing system.translation:
[计] 自组织系统
[化] 自组织系统

self-oscillation.translation:
n. 自激振荡
[电] 自生振荡
